name: lost-paint-studios-control-center
description: Studio Control Center for Lost Paint Studios

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit

author: Lost Paint Studios
